title: Off-duty Border Patrol agent arrested on two felony charges in Zapata County
excerpt: Lee Roy Zepeda, 47, an off-duty U.S. Border Patrol agent assigned to the Zapata Station, was arrested on two outstanding warrants for indecency with a child by sexual contact, the Zapata County Sheriff's Office said.
content:
The Zapata County Sheriff's Office announced on Wednesday, November 11, that an off-duty U.S. Border Patrol agent was arrested on two outstanding felony warrants.

Lee Roy Zepeda, 47, assigned to the Zapata Station, was arrested on two counts of indecency with a child by sexual contact, both second-degree felonies, according to the Sheriff's Office.

The investigation was conducted by the Sheriff's Office Criminal Investigations Division, with assistance from the Texas Rangers, and led to the issuance of the two felony arrest warrants, the Sheriff's Office said.

The Sheriff's Office said it will not release additional details about the case because of the sensitive nature of the allegations and to protect the privacy of those involved.

The Sheriff's Office said it remains committed to enforcing the law fairly and impartially, regardless of a person's profession or position.

The charges are allegations, and Zepeda is presumed innocent unless and until proven guilty in a court of law.

Source: Zapata County Sheriff's Office, November 11, 2026.
